description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
Hand-wired sentiment lexicon (~150 words) with 'not'/"n't" negation flipping; 2-layer model: char-offset copy heads + word-end detector MLP, uniform averaging readout.
lexicon-v1 plus sentence-initial word detectors (position-pinned neurons) so the first word of a sentence is counted.
lexicon-v2-start plus 'no ' as a negator (flips the following sentiment word).
lexicon-v3-no with the sentiment lexicon expanded from ~150 to ~400 general sentiment words.
lexicon-v4-big with the readout bias flipped to -0.5, so zero-score sentences (no lexicon hit) are predicted negative instead of positive.
lexicon-v4-big with the readout bias raised to +1.5, so sentences with a net score of -1 are still predicted positive.
lexicon-v4-big (bias +0.5) with each lexicon root expanded by common inflections (-s, -ly, -ness, -ed/-d, -ing).
lexicon-v7-morph plus a 'very ' intensifier neuron that doubles the score of the following word.
lexicon-v8-very with graded valence: ~50 intense words score +-2 instead of +-1.
lexicon-v9-strong plus a 3rd layer for contrast: words after 'but' are counted twice (attention-based after-but flag times score).
lexicon-v10-but with a second lexicon expansion (~250 more roots, pos and neg, with inflections).
lexicon-v11-big2 with a third lexicon expansion (~150 more roots, pos and neg).
lexicon-v12-big3 plus 'never ' as a negator (flips the following sentiment word).
lexicon-v13-never with per-layer widths: layer 1 has 1 head / 2 neurons, layer 2 has 2 heads / 1 neuron (same logic, far fewer parameters).
lexicon-v14-compact with 'however', 'though', 'although' added as contrast words that switch on the after-contrast weighting (like 'but').
lexicon-v15-contrast with ~30 ambiguous roots removed (like, fine, fresh, sad, tired, ...).
lexicon-v15-contrast (ambiguous-root removal reverted) with words after a contrast word weighted 3x instead of 2x.
lexicon-v17-after3x with negation as a cancel (-1x) instead of a flip (-2x): 'not good' -> 0.
lexicon-v17-after3x (negation flip restored) with a fourth lexicon round (~120 pos, ~120 neg roots).
lexicon-v19-big4 with intense words scored +-3 instead of +-2 (graded valence, 3 levels).
lexicon-v19-big4 with the sentence-initial word detectors ablated (value 0), to measure their effect.
lexicon-v19-big4 (sentence-initial detectors restored) with the after-contrast weighting ablated (words after 'but' etc. count 1x), to measure its effect.
lexicon-v19-big4 (contrast weighting restored to 3x) with the 'very ' intensifier ablated (value 0), to measure its effect.
lexicon-v19-big4 with 'not'/"n't"/'no' negation neurons ablated (value 0), to measure the effect of negation.
lexicon-v19-big4 with word-boundary checks added to the 'very', 'never' and 'no' detectors (fixes false hits like 'every good').
lexicon-v25-boundary plus 'really ' and 'so ' intensifiers (each adds the score again).
lexicon-v26-really-so with a fifth positive-lexicon round (~80 more positive roots).
lexicon-v27-pos5 with a fifth negative-lexicon round (~80 more negative roots).
lexicon-v28-neg5 with readout bias +2.5 (predict positive iff net score >= -1).
lexicon-v28-neg5 (bias back to +0.5) with ~25 more intense words weighted 2x.
lexicon-v30-strong2 with a sixth positive-lexicon round (~60 more positive roots).
lexicon-v31-pos6 with a sixth negative-lexicon round (~60 more negative roots).
lexicon-v32-neg6 with ~30 ambiguous roots removed (like, fine, fresh, sad, tired, ...), retested.
lexicon-v32-neg6 with attention sharpness beta reduced from 5000 to 50 (ablation: soft copy heads).
lexicon-v32-neg6 with attention sharpness beta reduced from 5000 to 500 (intermediate ablation).
lexicon-v32-neg6 (beta back to 5000) with the after-contrast weighting at 2x instead of 3x.
lexicon-v36-after2x (after-contrast 2x kept) with a seventh positive-lexicon round (~50 roots).
lexicon-v37-pos7 with a seventh negative-lexicon round (~60 roots).
lexicon-v38-neg7 with 'not' split from "n't": 'not' needs a word boundary before it.
lexicon-v39-notfix with an eighth negative-lexicon round (~40 more roots).
lexicon-v40-neg8 with an eighth positive-lexicon round (~40 more roots).
lexicon-v41-pos8 with the sentence-initial position-pin strength reduced from 1000 to 100.
lexicon-v41-pos8 (pin strength restored to 1000) with a ninth positive round of comparatives/superlatives.
lexicon-v43-pos9 with comparative/superlative inflections (-er/-est, -ier/-iest, -r/-st) added to every root.
lexicon-v44-comparatives with ~30 ambiguous roots removed (like, fine, fresh, sad, tired, ...), retested.
lexicon-v44-comparatives with 'but' as the only contrast word (however/though/although removed).
lexicon-v44-comparatives with the 'so ' and 'really ' intensifiers ablated (value 0).
lexicon-v44-comparatives (so/really restored) with intense words weighted +-3 instead of +-2.
lexicon-v48-strong3 with the sentence-initial detectors ablated again (value 0), to re-check their effect.

Final configuration: hand-wired sentiment lexicon (morphological inflections, intense words x2, negation via not/n't/no/never, very/really/so intensifiers, contrast words switching on 2x weighting after but/however/though/although, sentence-initial detectors, 80-char position-pinned copy heads).
